title: Passive-vs-active experimental protocol
interpretation: The protocol turns passive-vs-active distinction into lab steps. Passive OAM labeling must fail to reproduce active gate signatures, while operator-leg activation must reproduce I, X, Z, F3, and calibrated S readouts with leakage below thresholds and basis covariance after decoding.
honesty_boundary: Thresholds are engineering placeholders pending calibration. This is a protocol design, not experimental evidence.
